narr: Severe thunderstorms brought heavy rain, hail, gusty winds, and flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Pleasant Creek.
A flash flood with water several feet deep was reported on House Rock Valley Road. Time and location are approximate.
The Paria River near Kanab gauge peaked at 487 cfs after starting off dry at 0 cfs earlier in the day.
Flash flooding was reported in Grand Wash and water was over the road on state Route 24 in Capitol Reef National Park. Time is estimated from RADAR.
Flooding was reported on Interstate 70 between mileposts 96 and 103.
Flooding of dirt roads was reported in Hanksville.

Flash flooding in eastern Garfield County stranded 4 people on an elevated rock in Hog Canyon near state Route 95. Department of Public Safety helicopter and Swift Water Rescue crews were on standby. The individuals were able to move safely to dry ground. Time is estimated from radar.
The Huntington Power Plant reported flash flooding, and debris was reported across state Route 31. Location is approximate.
lsr: Flash flooding reported in Grand Wash by Capitol Reef National Park rangers. Time estimated from radar.
